The air in a room is heated by a heater. The diagram shows the circulation of the air in the room.
circulation
of air
room

Which statement about the air that is heated is correct?
A
The air contracts and becomes less dense.
B
The air contracts and becomes more dense.
C
The air expands and becomes less dense.
D
The air expands and becomes more dense.

options.label: A
options.text: The air contracts and becomes less dense.

options.label: B
options.text: The air contracts and becomes more dense.

options.label: C
options.text: The air expands and becomes less dense.

options.label: D
options.text: The air expands and becomes more dense.
